items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Williams. No, no. Sonny Terry in New York. You never made a place. [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't know his name, but I can't call it now.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And you remember any of the other guys from Gabriel's band?
Nobody but Sean, the singer-boy, used to sing. And Joe, them one of the two I remember.
Were they, did they play writing music, or what?
